payload.title: A generated image never shows a real person
payload.description:
Ryan's decision: no real likenesses.

```gherkin
Feature: No real likenesses

  Scenario: The prompt names no real person
    Given a piece about a real politician
    When its image is generated
    Then the prompt contains no real person's name or description

  Scenario: A provider refusal falls back
    Given the first image provider refuses the request
    When the image is generated
    Then the next provider is tried
    And the refusal is recorded
```
